# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen at introduction, and approximately eighteen by the end of Volume 2.  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c30 P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c24 P49](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0049)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher and student  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c7 P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008)</sub>
- **Titles:** Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>; President of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome lad with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a broad-shouldered, manly build. He has a firm, splendid chin and a mouth often twisted into a teasing smile. As he matures into young adulthood, he is described as tall, frank-faced, and manly in appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, ambitious, and determined to excel in his studies and make the best of life. He has a teasing, mischievous streak and loves a good joke, but he is also self-sacrificing, honorable, and deeply courteous. Good-tempered and friendly, he maintains high personal ideals and takes pride in being a dependable, hardworking young man.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)_

## Goals

- To earn his own way through college and become a doctor  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013)</sub>
- To excel in his education and win academic distinctions  <sub>[v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>
- To win Anne Shirley's friendship and eventually her love  <sub>[v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v2 c30 P42](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0042)</sub>

## History

After living in Alberta for three years due to his father's poor health, Gilbert returned home to Avonlea and joined the local school. On his first day back, he teased Anne Shirley by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting her to smash her slate over his head; despite his prompt apologies, Anne held a long grudge against him. Throughout their school years, Gilbert engaged in an academic rivalry with Anne, leading their classes at Avonlea and later at Queen's Academy, where he earned his teacher's license in a single year and won the Governor General's Medal. When his father could not afford to send him straight to college, Gilbert agreed to teach at Avonlea, but surrendered the post to Anne so she could stay near Marilla, taking the White Sands school instead. This selfless act led Anne to finally forgive him, starting a close friendship. Gilbert became president of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, taught at White Sands for a year, and worked toward studying medicine. At the end of two years, he prepared to leave for Redmond College alongside Anne as her devoted friend and secret admirer.

## Background by volume

- Spent three years living in Alberta with his sick father before returning to Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Son of John Blythe, who was a youth friend and suitor of Marilla Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy and won the Bronze Medal  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>

## Quotes

> It was my fault Mr. Phillips. I teased her.  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)</sub>

> I’m awfully sorry I made fun of your hair, Anne. Honest I am. Don’t be mad for keeps, now.  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>

> Anne, look here. Can’t we be good friends? I’m awfully sorry I made fun of your hair that time. I didn’t mean to vex you and I only meant it for a joke. Besides, it’s so long ago. I think your hair is awfully pretty now—honest I do. Let’s be friends.  <sub>[v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031)</sub>

> It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?  <sub>[v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>

> We are going to be the best of friends. We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you.  <sub>[v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)</sub>
